includes.title: What Plus includes
includes.free: Profiles, marks and the core stats stay free for everyone — with Plus or without.

trial.question: How does the trial work?
trial.answer: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of Plus for free and without a card — once per user and per Lesta account. You need a linked account. If a friend invited you, the trial is {referralDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. It does not renew on its own: Plus simply switches off afterwards.

free.question: What stays free?
free.answer: All the essentials: profiles and stats of any player, marks and thresholds, tank tables, the tech tree, news, leaderboards, sessions, replays, clans, community, tools and the API. The heavy tools, 3D armor and detailed battle analysis, are free within a monthly allowance. Plus sells our analytics, room and conveniences, not Lesta data.

payment.question: How does payment work?
payment.answer: Payments open later: for now the trial and promo codes are available. YooKassa will take the payment — Three Marks never stores your card details and only receives a masked number for auto-renew.

cancel.question: Can I cancel?
cancel.answer: Yes, any time: turn auto-renew off in your account with one click, and Plus keeps working until the end of the paid period. We refund the unused days on request to support — see the <terms>refund terms</terms>.

expiry.question: What happens when Plus ends?
expiry.answer: Analytics go back to the free window, extra overlays are paused, goals and accounts over the limit stay viewable, and replays over the free limit stay read-only for {days} days and are then removed (we warn you in advance). Renew Plus and everything comes back at once.

noAds.question: Will there be ads?
noAds.answer: No — with or without a subscription.

data.question: Where does the data come from?
data.answer: Stats come from Lesta's public data and from our mod if you have it installed. Three Marks is a fan project not affiliated with Lesta. We never ask for your game password: sign-in is via Lesta ID only.

promo.question: How do I use a promo code?
promo.answer: A free-days code is redeemed in your account under “Subscription” — the days are added to your current period. A discount code is entered at checkout on this page once payments open.
